## Quantum interference picture

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const root = html`<div class="interference-widget">
    <div class="interference-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Wave-packet explanation">
      <button type="button" data-tab="0" role="tab" aria-selected="true">x packet</button>
      <button type="button" data-tab="1" role="tab" aria-selected="false">motion</button>
      <button type="button" data-tab="2" role="tab" aria-selected="false">velocity space</button>
      <button type="button" data-tab="3" role="tab" aria-selected="false">interaction wave</button>
      <button type="button" data-tab="4" role="tab" aria-selected="false">sum and drift</button>
    </div>

    <div class="interference-controls">
      <label>
        <span>charge product</span>
        <select name="chargeProduct">
          <option value="-1">q1 q2 &lt; 0: attraction</option>
          <option value="1">q1 q2 &gt; 0: repulsion</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <label>
        <span>mean velocity v0</span>
        <input name="meanVelocity" type="range" min="-1.1" max="1.1" step="0.05" value="0">
        <output></output>
      </label>
    </div>

    <div class="interference-plot" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>`;

  const plot = root.querySelector(".interference-plot");
  const buttons = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]"));
  const chargeProduct = root.querySelector("[name='chargeProduct']");
  const meanVelocity = root.querySelector("[name='meanVelocity']");
  const meanVelocityOut = meanVelocity.nextElementSibling;
  const state = {tab: 0};

  const width = 1120;
  const height = 560;
  const colors = {
    axis: "#d7dde8",
    grid: "#233044",
    muted: "#9fb0c7",
    initial: "#d7dde8",
    interaction: "#58a6ff",
    final: "#ffcc4d",
    attraction: "#8ec5ff",
    repulsion: "#ff9f5a",
    constructive: "rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.16)",
    destructive: "rgba(255, 117, 117, 0.14)"
  };

  const gaussian = (x, mu, sigma) => Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mu) / sigma) ** 2);
  const interactionWave = (v, v0, direction) => {
    const z = (v - v0) / 0.74;
    return 0.48 * direction * z * Math.exp(-0.5 * z * z);
  };
  const resultWave = (v, v0, direction) => (
    gaussian(v, v0, 0.82) + interactionWave(v, v0, direction)
  );

  const samplePath = (xmin, xmax, steps, sx, sy, fn) => {
    let d = "";
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const x = xmin + (xmax - xmin) * i / steps;
      d += `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${sx(x).toFixed(1)} ${sy(fn(x)).toFixed(1)} `;
    }
    return d;
  };

  const axis = ({left, top, plotWidth, plotHeight, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, xLabel, yLabel, ticks = [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3]}) => {
    const sx = (x) => left + (x - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * plotWidth;
    const sy = (y) => top + (ymax - y) / (ymax - ymin) * plotHeight;
    const xAxisY = sy(0);
    const yAxisX = sx(0);
    const grid = ticks.map((t) => `
      <line x1="${sx(t)}" y1="${top}" x2="${sx(t)}" y2="${top + plotHeight}" class="interference-grid"/>
      <text x="${sx(t)}" y="${top + plotHeight + 28}" class="interference-tick">${t}</text>
    `).join("");

    return {
      sx,
      sy,
      markup: `
        <rect x="${left}" y="${top}" width="${plotWidth}" height="${plotHeight}" class="interference-panel"/>
        ${grid}
        <line x1="${left}" y1="${xAxisY}" x2="${left + plotWidth + 20}" y2="${xAxisY}" class="interference-axis" marker-end="url(#qi-arrow)"/>
        <line x1="${yAxisX}" y1="${top + plotHeight}" x2="${yAxisX}" y2="${top - 16}" class="interference-axis" marker-end="url(#qi-arrow)"/>
        <text x="${left + plotWidth}" y="${top + plotHeight + 58}" class="interference-axis-label">${xLabel}</text>
        <text x="${yAxisX + 16}" y="${top + 18}" class="interference-axis-label">${yLabel}</text>
      `
    };
  };

  const defs = () => `
    <defs>
      <marker id="qi-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="4.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
        <path d="M 0 0 L 9 4.5 L 0 9 Z" fill="${colors.axis}"/>
      </marker>
      <filter id="qi-glow" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="blur"/>
        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
        </feMerge>
      </filter>
    </defs>
  `;

  const title = (main, sub) => `
    <text x="56" y="48" class="interference-title">${main}</text>
    <text x="56" y="82" class="interference-subtitle">${sub}</text>
  `;

  const svg = (body) => `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" aria-label="Wave-packet interference explanation">
      ${defs()}
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" rx="16" class="interference-bg"/>
      ${body}
    </svg>
  `;

  const tabXPacket = () => {
    const ax = axis({left: 92, top: 122, plotWidth: 920, plotHeight: 320, xmin: -4, xmax: 4, ymin: -0.05, ymax: 1.18, xLabel: "position x", yLabel: "amplitude"});
    const packet = samplePath(-4, 4, 220, ax.sx, ax.sy, (x) => gaussian(x, 0, 0.82));
    return svg(`
      ${title("1. A localized wave packet", "In x-space the particle is represented by a wave packet, not by a point.")}
      ${ax.markup}
      <path d="${packet}" class="interference-curve interference-initial interference-draw"/>
      <line x1="${ax.sx(0)}" y1="${ax.sy(-0.02)}" x2="${ax.sx(0)}" y2="${ax.sy(1.04)}" class="interference-centerline"/>
      <text x="${ax.sx(0) + 18}" y="${ax.sy(0.94)}" class="interference-label">center of the packet</text>
    `);
  };

  const tabMotion = (v0) => {
    const ax = axis({left: 92, top: 122, plotWidth: 920, plotHeight: 320, xmin: -4, xmax: 4, ymin: -0.05, ymax: 1.18, xLabel: "position x", yLabel: "amplitude"});
    const shift = 1.5 * v0;
    const initial = samplePath(-4, 4, 220, ax.sx, ax.sy, (x) => gaussian(x, 0, 0.82));
    const moved = samplePath(-4, 4, 220, ax.sx, ax.sy, (x) => gaussian(x, shift, 0.82));
    const label = v0 > 0.03 ? "&lt;v&gt; &gt; 0" : (v0 < -0.03 ? "&lt;v&gt; &lt; 0" : "&lt;v&gt; = 0");
    return svg(`
      ${title("2. Motion is the drift of the packet", "Changing the mean velocity only shifts the packet center in time.")}
      ${ax.markup}
      <path d="${initial}" class="interference-curve interference-ghost"/>
      <path d="${moved}" class="interference-curve interference-final interference-slide"/>
      <line x1="${ax.sx(0)}" y1="${ax.sy(0.42)}" x2="${ax.sx(shift)}" y2="${ax.sy(0.42)}" class="interference-arrow" marker-end="url(#qi-arrow)"/>
      <text x="${ax.sx(shift) + (v0 >= 0 ? 18 : -18)}" y="${ax.sy(0.52)}" class="interference-label ${v0 >= 0 ? "" : "interference-label-left"}">${label}</text>
    `);
  };

  const tabVelocity = (v0) => {
    const ax = axis({left: 92, top: 122, plotWidth: 920, plotHeight: 320, xmin: -3.2, xmax: 3.2, ymin: -0.05, ymax: 1.18, xLabel: "velocity v", yLabel: "amplitude"});
    const packet = samplePath(-3.2, 3.2, 220, ax.sx, ax.sy, (v) => gaussian(v, v0, 0.82));
    return svg(`
      ${title("3. The same packet in velocity space", "A moving packet is a Gaussian shifted away from v = 0; its width stays fixed.")}
      ${ax.markup}
      <path d="${packet}" class="interference-curve interference-initial interference-draw"/>
      <line x1="${ax.sx(v0)}" y1="${ax.sy(-0.02)}" x2="${ax.sx(v0)}" y2="${ax.sy(1.02)}" class="interference-centerline"/>
      <text x="${ax.sx(v0) + 18}" y="${ax.sy(0.92)}" class="interference-label">mean velocity v0 = ${v0.toFixed(2)}</text>
    `);
  };

  const tabInteraction = (v0, direction, modeLabel) => {
    const ax = axis({left: 92, top: 122, plotWidth: 920, plotHeight: 320, xmin: -3.2, xmax: 3.2, ymin: -0.55, ymax: 1.18, xLabel: "velocity v", yLabel: "amplitude"});
    const incoming = samplePath(-3.2, 3.2, 240, ax.sx, ax.sy, (v) => gaussian(v, v0, 0.82));
    const produced = samplePath(-3.2, 3.2, 240, ax.sx, ax.sy, (v) => interactionWave(v, v0, direction));
    const plusSide = direction > 0 ? [v0, 3.2] : [-3.2, v0];
    const minusSide = direction > 0 ? [-3.2, v0] : [v0, 3.2];
    return svg(`
      ${title("4. The interaction creates an extra wave", `${modeLabel}: the produced wave has opposite signs on the two sides of the packet.`)}
      ${ax.markup}
      <rect x="${ax.sx(plusSide[0])}" y="${ax.sy(1.16)}" width="${Math.abs(ax.sx(plusSide[1]) - ax.sx(plusSide[0]))}" height="${ax.sy(-0.52) - ax.sy(1.16)}" class="interference-constructive"/>
      <rect x="${ax.sx(minusSide[0])}" y="${ax.sy(1.16)}" width="${Math.abs(ax.sx(minusSide[1]) - ax.sx(minusSide[0]))}" height="${ax.sy(-0.52) - ax.sy(1.16)}" class="interference-destructive"/>
      <path d="${incoming}" class="interference-curve interference-ghost"/>
      <path d="${produced}" class="interference-curve interference-interaction interference-draw"/>
      <text x="${ax.sx(direction > 0 ? 1.85 : -1.85)}" y="${ax.sy(0.78)}" class="interference-label">constructive</text>
      <text x="${ax.sx(direction > 0 ? -1.85 : 1.85)}" y="${ax.sy(-0.28)}" class="interference-label">destructive</text>
    `);
  };

  const tabSum = (v0, direction, modeLabel) => {
    const top = axis({left: 78, top: 102, plotWidth: 450, plotHeight: 210, xmin: -3.2, xmax: 3.2, ymin: -0.35, ymax: 1.24, xLabel: "velocity v", yLabel: "amplitude", ticks: [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3]});
    const bottom = axis({left: 608, top: 102, plotWidth: 430, plotHeight: 210, xmin: -4, xmax: 4, ymin: -0.05, ymax: 1.18, xLabel: "position x", yLabel: "amplitude", ticks: [-4, -2, 0, 2, 4]});
    const initialV = samplePath(-3.2, 3.2, 220, top.sx, top.sy, (v) => gaussian(v, v0, 0.82));
    const producedV = samplePath(-3.2, 3.2, 220, top.sx, top.sy, (v) => interactionWave(v, v0, direction));
    const finalV = samplePath(-3.2, 3.2, 220, top.sx, top.sy, (v) => resultWave(v, v0, direction));
    const drift = 1.15 * (v0 + 0.48 * direction);
    const initialX = samplePath(-4, 4, 220, bottom.sx, bottom.sy, (x) => gaussian(x, 0, 0.82));
    const finalX = samplePath(-4, 4, 220, bottom.sx, bottom.sy, (x) => gaussian(x, drift, 0.82));
    const signLabel = direction > 0 ? "&lt;v&gt; shifts to the right" : "&lt;v&gt; shifts to the left";
    return svg(`
      ${title("5. The observed packet is the sum", `${modeLabel}: interference redistributes probability and shifts the packet center.`)}
      ${top.markup}
      ${bottom.markup}
      <path d="${initialV}" class="interference-curve interference-ghost"/>
      <path d="${producedV}" class="interference-curve interference-interaction"/>
      <path d="${finalV}" class="interference-curve interference-final interference-draw"/>
      <text x="${top.sx(-2.95)}" y="${top.sy(1.1)}" class="interference-label">incoming + produced</text>
      <path d="${initialX}" class="interference-curve interference-ghost"/>
      <path d="${finalX}" class="interference-curve interference-final interference-slide"/>
      <line x1="${bottom.sx(0)}" y1="${bottom.sy(0.38)}" x2="${bottom.sx(drift)}" y2="${bottom.sy(0.38)}" class="interference-arrow" marker-end="url(#qi-arrow)"/>
      <text x="${bottom.sx(drift) + (direction > 0 ? 18 : -18)}" y="${bottom.sy(0.5)}" class="interference-label ${direction > 0 ? "" : "interference-label-left"}">${signLabel}</text>
      <text x="80" y="474" class="interference-summary">The force is not inserted as a Newtonian push. It appears as a phase-sensitive sum of waves.</text>
    `);
  };

  function render() {
    const v0 = Number(meanVelocity.value);
    const q12 = Number(chargeProduct.value);
    const direction = q12 < 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const modeLabel = q12 < 0 ? "attraction" : "repulsion";
    meanVelocityOut.textContent = v0.toFixed(2);
    buttons.forEach((button, index) => button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(index === state.tab)));

    if (state.tab === 0) plot.innerHTML = tabXPacket();
    if (state.tab === 1) plot.innerHTML = tabMotion(v0);
    if (state.tab === 2) plot.innerHTML = tabVelocity(v0);
    if (state.tab === 3) plot.innerHTML = tabInteraction(v0, direction, modeLabel);
    if (state.tab === 4) plot.innerHTML = tabSum(v0, direction, modeLabel);
  }

  buttons.forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.tab = Number(button.dataset.tab);
      render();
    });
  });
  chargeProduct.addEventListener("change", render);
  meanVelocity.addEventListener("input", render);
  render();

  return root;
}
```
